prompt: Write a validator that reads @NotBlank and @Min off an object's fields with reflection and reports every rule that is broken. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Annotations are only visible to reflection when they are declared with @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME); without it the compiler drops them from the class file. isAnnotationPresent asks whether a field carries a marker, and getAnnotation hands back the annotation instance so you can read its members, such as Min.value(). Because setAccessible(true) unlocks private fields, one generic loop can validate any model class without knowing anything about it in advance. Collecting messages in declared-field order keeps the output predictable for the caller.
hints: Start with for (Field field : target.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) and call field.setAccessible(true) before reading anything.
field.isAnnotationPresent(NotBlank.class) tells you whether the rule applies; field.getAnnotation(Min.class).value() gives you the number from @Min(18).
field.get(target) returns Object, so an int field comes back as an Integer -- cast it to Number and call intValue(). For @NotBlank, treat null and a value whose trim() is empty the same way.
